title: Age of Empires IV: Anniversary Edition
provenance: Reported by himbeles (highball-db#1289, 2026-11-17), Apple M2 Max, macOS 27.2.1, Highball 0.10.26, engine x64-crossover26.3-aoe4-r1, D3DMetal, rated 5 of 5 after 13 minutes: an engine id Highball doesn't ship, not described in the report. AVX advertised, the Metal HUD on. Not verified by the maintainer. A separate local test on 2026-11-17 reached Late Siege and moved 42 units using engine PR #49 (ba28330), the patched shared x87sidecar, D3DMetal and MSync. DXMT was not tested in that run.
notes: The opt-in recipe selects D3DMetal and sets HB_AOE4=1. Requires an AoE IV-capable Wine 11 engine with the patched x87sidecar installed, Rosetta and macOS 26 or later. The upstream engine manifest pin is pending. Small stutters have been observed in Late Siege.
